reason: ADR-0253 §10 requires that a Host-run turn's usage row is never lost when its write fails. No existing durable queue accepts arbitrary work and the shared durable-queue primitive (ADR-0250 §6.1) is not built yet, so usageWriteOutbox keeps only rows whose write failed, on the shared decideNextAttempt curve. Phase 1 moves it onto the primitive with the other queues.
